newsitem.title: UK: Argentine Army Chief to visit Britain.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Army Chief to visit Britain.

text.p: Argentina's General Martin Balza will visit Britain in November in the first visit by an Argentine Army Chief since the two countries went to war in 1982 over the Falkland Islands.

The Argentine embassy said on Wednesday that Balza, who fought in the South Atlantic conflict, would pay a confidence-building visit from November 4-6 aimed at boosting ties between the former enemies.

Despite Buenos Aires' constitutional claim to the disputed islands, Britain and Argentina restored diplomatic links in 1990 and last year signed an agreement on a framework for oil and gas exploration in Falkland waters.

But the island authorities, target of an Argentine invasion force in 1982, snubbed Buenos Aires this week by failing to allow Argentina's YPF oil company to drill for oil in waters surrounding the disputed territory.
